# VM23G

> VM23G (VM23 Group) is a Singapore-based group uniting AI systems, web and app design, brand and media, and movement-led wellness. Brand line: MIND. BODY. BRAND. TECHNOLOGY.

VM23G operates through two specialist arms:
- AaVisions — tech, AI, web, app and marketing consulting: web design and app development, sales and performance consultations, AI workflow automation, UI/UX design and digital transformation. Led by Summan Misir Veera.
- NavaFit Alignment — mind and body wellness: fitness branding, physical alignment and movement education, mind/body alignment programmes, and Kalari, Gadah and breathwork-inspired training. Founded and led by Tinesh Awai Veera.

Founders:
- Summan Misir Veera — Founder, Managing Director (associated with AaVisions).
- Tinesh Awai Veera — Co-founder (associated with NavaFit Alignment).

Published product: NavaFit Alignment, an iOS app on the Apple App Store (Singapore): https://apps.apple.com/sg/app/navafit-alignment/id6761351480

Enquiries: use the Start a Project form at https://veeramisir.com/start
